proposal.reason: Main substantive change is a new `symm_alltoall` path in `sendRecvPcclUnitTest` that exercises symmetric window registration and grouped Send/Recv all-to-all exchanges, verifies symmetric DMA batch selection via tuning logs, and validates per-element source/destination payload correctness. The workflow/CSV/build-script/docs updates are supporting test/CI plumbing for this new symmetric test coverage, not independent policy/protocol changes.
